name: Kanda
tagline: Tokyo in 3 minutes and Otemachi in 9 minutes. Served by 4 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥140,000 to ¥150,000.
summary: The station is in Chiyoda City, where JR East and Tokyo Metro run 4 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 9 minutes to Otemachi, 13 minutes to Shinjuku, 22 minutes to Shibuya and 17 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥140,000 to ¥150,000. The station stands 4.6 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 2.1 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 4.6 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 3.8 m to 5.9 m, a difference of 2.1 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of less than 0.5 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 6 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is 0.5 to 3 m. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 30 clinics and 29 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is 同仁記念会明和病院, about 7 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 秋葉原メディカルクリニック, about 11 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 4 lines serve the station. JR Yamanote Line and JR Chuo Rapid Line run through it. JR Keihin-Tohoku Line also call here. Tokyo Metro Ginza Line are available too. The lines are split between operators (JR East runs 3 lines and Tokyo Metro runs 1 line), so when one line stops you can change to a line run by a different company.
congestion: JR Keihin-Tohoku Line runs at 159% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 大井町→品川, which this station is not on. JR Chuo Rapid Line runs at 158%. Its busiest stretch is 中野→新宿, which this station is likewise not on. Tokyo Metro Ginza Line runs at 153%. Its busiest stretch is 赤坂見附→溜池山王, which this station is likewise not on. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥140,000 to ¥150,000 and 1K ¥140,000 to ¥150,000. 1LDK ¥230,000 to ¥240,000 and 2LDK ¥300,000 to ¥310,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

noiseSources: The 首都高速1号上野線 viaduct runs a short walk from the station. It is an expressway, so traffic is audible day and night
中央通り (2 lanes each way) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 13 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 3 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Among the 23 wards' stations, comparatively few of the points around this one fall inside the projected inundation area for the largest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: 4 lines serve the station, and the choice of connections is wider than at most stations in the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are among the lowest in the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are heavily loaded in the morning.
leads.noiseSources: The big roads are far enough that traffic noise is unlikely to bother you.
